The '''Gwori system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gwori]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="SoD" />
